trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the goal to book a follow-up appointment.
steps.text: Hi, मुझे cardiology follow-up book करना है।

steps.purpose: Ask for the patient ID to proceed.
steps.expected_behavior: Prompt the user for their patient ID to check their registration.
steps.text: ज़रूर, क्या आप अपना patient ID बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The rules state an unregistered patient cannot be booked, so the agent must look up the record first.

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and preferred timeframe.
steps.text: PT-1001. मुझे next week का slot चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Retrieve patient record using the provided ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_patient_record with the patient ID provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent needs to verify registration and previous department history before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge record retrieval and ask for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask the user for identity verification factors.
steps.text: Record मिल गया है। Verification के लिए अपना registered नाम और date of birth बताइए।
steps.planner_rationale: Before disclosing specific slots or booking, the agent must verify the caller's identity.

steps.purpose: Provide verification details (with an STT error on the name).
steps.text: मेरा नाम Bikram है। मेरा जन्म 12 May 1980 को हुआ था।
steps.clean_text: मेरा नाम Vikram है। मेरा जन्म 12 May 1980 को हुआ था।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा नाम Bikram है। मेरा जन्म 12 May 1980 को हुआ था।

steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the factors provided.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent verifies the identity of the user to ensure it is the account holder.

steps.purpose: Return the outcome of the identity verification.
Check available slots for the cardiology department.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_doctor_availability for cardiology for the next 7 days.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent can now look up real availability for the requested timeframe.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for the requested department.
Present the available slots and consultation fee to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: State the available slots, doctor, and fee exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Verification successful. Dr. Sharma के पास next week Monday 10:00 AM और Wednesday 4:00 PM के slots हैं। Consultation fee 1500 rupees है। कौनसा book करूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding response on tool output without hallucinating details.

steps.text: Wednesday 4 PM वाला ठीक है। जल्दी book कर दीजिए।

steps.expected_behavior: Reuse patient ID collected earlier without asking again, and book the chosen slot.
steps.planner_rationale: Slot value recall demonstrated by using PT-1001 from turn 3 without re-asking.

steps.purpose: Confirm the appointment with the booking reference.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm booking with reference ID and details strictly from the tool.
steps.text: आपका appointment confirm हो गया है। Booking reference BKG-5542 है। Dr. Sharma, Wednesday 4:00 PM.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding response entirely on the booking tool result to ensure accuracy.

steps.text: Payment अभी online करना होगा या hospital में?

steps.expected_behavior: Reiterate the fee from the tool and explicitly state that payment location information is unavailable.
steps.text: Consultation fee 1500 rupees है, लेकिन payment online होगा या hospital में, इसकी जानकारी मेरे पास नहीं है।
steps.planner_rationale: Address the user's question securely based on grounded fee without hallucinating payment policy.

steps.text: ठीक है। और कुछ नहीं चाहिए। Thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.

variant_findings.reason: While the assistant successfully grounds its responses on tool outputs in e12 and e16, it explicitly violates the negative constraint of this variant in e18 by making an unsupported forward guarantee about the payment process ('hospital आकर ही pay करनी होगी'), which was not returned by any tool.

issues.detail: In e18, the assistant hallucinates a payment policy ('hospital आकर ही pay करनी होगी') in response to the user's question. Because this information is not present in any tool output, it violates the Tool Output Grounding requirement which strictly forbids unsupported forward guarantees.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e18 so the assistant reiterates the fee amount but explicitly states that it does not have information regarding whether the payment must be made online or at the hospital, thereby avoiding any ungrounded claims.

verification.summary: The conversation accurately reflects the persona and follows the logical steps to verify identity and book an appointment, successfully demonstrating slot value recall. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant when the assistant invents a payment policy in turn 18 that was not returned by any tool. A surface repair to correct this ungrounded claim is required.
